listing.name: Knytt Stories (YKnytt)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for YKnytt; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream Knytt Stories implementation0.7.3. Individual-level bugs tracked; whole community-level corpus compatibility not established. Godot C# engine release Windows/Linux/macOS/Android plus ARM handhelds; preserve level-compatibility limits and no automatic claim entire user-level corpus works. Upstream platforms: Windows/macOS/Linux x64/Android and Linux ARM64 handhelds. Godot3.6.1 Mono/.NET build requirements documented. Original data: Knytt Stories levels/world data compatible with YKnytt. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
